## `generic_imu_app_test.rb`

**경로:** `gsw/cosmos/COMPONENTS/GENERIC_IMU/procedures/tests/generic_imu_app_test.rb`


```text
require 'cosmos'
require 'cosmos/script'
require "generic_imu_lib.rb"

##
## This script tests the standard cFS component application functionality.
## Currently this includes: 
##   Housekeeping, request telemetry to be published on the software bus
##   NOOP, no operation but confirm correct counters increment
##   Reset counters, increment as done in NOOP and confirm ability to clear repeatably
##   Invalid ground command, confirm bad lengths and codes are rejected
##


##
##   Housekeeping, request telemetry to be published on the software bus
##
GENERIC_IMU_TEST_LOOP_COUNT.times do |n|
    get_generic_imu_hk()
end


##
## NOOP, no operation but confirm correct counters increment
##
GENERIC_IMU_TEST_LOOP_COUNT.times do |n|
    generic_imu_cmd("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_NOOP_CC")
end


##
## Reset counters, increment as done in NOOP and confirm ability to clear repeatably
##
GENERIC_IMU_TEST_LOOP_COUNT.times do |n|
    generic_imu_cmd("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_NOOP_CC")
    cmd("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_RST_COUNTERS_CC") # Note standard `cmd` as we can't reset counters and then confirm increment
    get_generic_imu_hk()
    check("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT == 0")
    check("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT == 0")
end


##
##   Invalid ground command, confirm bad lengths and codes are rejected
##
GENERIC_IMU_TEST_LOOP_COUNT.times do |n|
    # Bad length
    cmd_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT")
    cmd_err_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT")
    cmd("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_NOOP_CC with CCSDS_LENGTH #{n+2}") # Note +2 due to CCSDS already being +1
    get_generic_imu_hk()
    check("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT == #{cmd_cnt}")
    check("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT == #{cmd_err_cnt+1}")
end

for n in 6..(5 + GENERIC_IMU_TEST_LOOP_COUNT)
    # Bad command codes
    cmd_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT")
    cmd_err_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT")
    cmd("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_NOOP_CC with CCSDS_FC #{n+1}")
    get_generic_imu_hk()
    check("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT == #{cmd_cnt}")
    check("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT == #{cmd_err_cnt+1}")
end
```

## `generic_imu_ast_test.rb`

**경로:** `gsw/cosmos/COMPONENTS/GENERIC_IMU/procedures/tests/generic_imu_ast_test.rb`


```text
require 'cosmos'
require 'cosmos/script'
require "generic_imu_lib.rb"

##
## This script tests the cFS component device functionality.
## Currently this includes: 
##   Enable / disable, control hardware communications
##   Configuration, reconfigure generic_imu instrument register
##


##
## Enable / disable, control hardware communications
##
GENERIC_IMU_TEST_LOOP_COUNT.times do |n|
    safe_generic_imu() # Get to known state

    # Manually command to disable when already disabled
    cmd_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT")
    cmd_err_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT")
    cmd("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_DISABLE_CC")
    get_generic_imu_hk()
    check("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT == #{cmd_cnt}")
    check("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT == #{cmd_err_cnt+1}")

    # Enable
    enable_generic_imu()

    # Confirm device counters increment without errors
    confirm_generic_imu_data_loop()

    # Manually command to enable when already enabled
    cmd_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT")
    cmd_err_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT")
    cmd("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_ENABLE_CC")
    get_generic_imu_hk()
    check("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT == #{cmd_cnt}")
    check("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT == #{cmd_err_cnt+1}")

    # Reconfirm data remains as expected
    confirm_generic_imu_data_loop()

    # Disable
    disable_generic_imu()
end
```

require 'cosmos'
require 'cosmos/script'

## This script tests the cFS component device functionality.
## Currently this includes: 
##   Enable / disable, control hardware communications
##   Configuration, reconfigure generic_imu instrument register
##


##
## Enable / disable, control hardware communications
##
GENERIC_IMU_TEST_LOOP_COUNT.times do |n|
    safe_generic_imu() # Get to known state

    # Manually command to disable when already disabled
    cmd_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT")
    cmd_err_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT")
    cmd("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_DISABLE_CC")
    get_generic_imu_hk()

    check("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT == #{cmd_err_cnt+1}")

    # Enable

    # Confirm device counters increment without errors
    confirm_generic_imu_data_loop()

    # Manually command to enable when already enabled
    cmd_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_COUNT")
    cmd_err_cnt = tlm("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT")
    cmd("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_ENABLE_CC")
    get_generic_imu_hk()

    check("GENERIC_IMU GENERIC_IMU_HK_TLM CMD_ERR_COUNT == #{cmd_err_cnt+1}")
